basic_profile.bio: I'm a graduate student pursuing a degree in Speech-Language Pathology, located in the Midwest USA. I have a keen interest in animation and gaming, spending my free time between drawing and watching gaming channels like NeebsGaming. I recently transitioned from a retail job to a more stable position, which allows me to work flexible hours around my studies. I'm currently single and often online late at night, usually between 10 PM to 1 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background primarily in Speech-Language Pathology, I gained most of my knowledge through formal education and coursework. Recently, I've been exploring animation and gaming as hobbies, learning through online tutorials and community forums.
